sections.description:
A new patch is now live on PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that prevented special event music for Ana’s Bastet Challenge from playing in the main menu
- Fixed a bug that prevented heroes from loading on the victory screen
- Fixed a bug that caused Wrecking Ball’s golden weapon to display incorrectly when using certain skins
